scope: Cross-class verification of the dual-allocator-scope finding on the 9 sibling LTC/LGTC classes (GroupBase, ItemBase, WidgetHandle, Math, CommandBase, JudgeBase, QuestBase, String, Table). **CONFIRMED at byte level via direct BCA dump**: GroupBase BCA (0x0115D5C0) is IDENTICAL to StatusBase BCA (0x0115F858) for all 10 BCDs except the +96 BCD which varies (LTC vs LGTC). The LGE-chain BCDs at +4 and +100 are SHARED BCD INSTANCES across all 10 classes (same memory addresses). Therefore the interpretation (dual allocator scopes: actor-side via ActorBase, Lua-side via LTC/LGTC) extends UNIFORMLY to all 10 LTC/LGTC family classes. No new BCS-Y entries needed - 11 amendments documenting the cross-class scope.

method.step1: Located 10 LTC/LGTC class TDs in the catalog (all cataloged earlier): StatusBase (BCS-Y-1497), GroupBase (BCS-Y-1588), ItemBase (BCS-Y-1589), WidgetHandle (BCS-Y-1590), Math (BCS-Y-1591), CommandBase (BCS-Y-1593), JudgeBase (BCS-Y-1594), QuestBase (BCS-Y-1595), String (BCS-Y-1596), Table (BCS-Y-1597). Plus Global (BCS-Y-1592) is the outlier (deferred).
method.step2: Spot-checked GroupBase BCA at 0x0115D5C0 (11 BCDs) via DumpMemRange. Compared to StatusBase BCA at 0x0115F858. **Result**: 10 of 11 BCD pointers are IDENTICAL byte-for-byte (same BCD addresses). The 1 varying BCD is at offset +96 in the array (BCD #7): GroupBase has 0x0115D60C (LTC's BCD pointing to LTC TD 0x012C0828); StatusBase has 0x0115D8CC (LGTC's BCD pointing to LGTC TD 0x012C0A28). The LGE-chain BCDs at +4 (0x0115C6F8, 0x0115C714, 0x0115C730) and +100 (0x0115D668, 0x0115D684, 0x0115D6A0) are SHARED across both classes.
method.step3: Per the previously-established BCA uniformity finding (manifest cross_class_rtti.json), the 10 of 11 LTC/LGTC classes share the same 11-BCD inheritance footprint at the 4 vftable positions (0/+4/+96/+100). This still holds and applies the interpretation: all 10 classes have TWO independent LGE allocator-state subobjects (one via ActorBase at +4, one via LTC/LGTC at +100), implementing dual allocator scopes (actor-side + Lua-side).
method.step4: Catalog 11 amendments documenting the cross-class scope: 10 amendments to the LTC/LGTC TDs (each notes that the dual-scope finding applies) + 1 amendment to LGTC TD (BCS-Y-1498) noting its role in providing the Lua-side allocator subobject. No new BCS-Y entries needed - all 10 LTC/LGTC TDs were cataloged earlier.

key_findings: **the BCA uniformity CONFIRMED at byte level**: GroupBase BCA (0x0115D5C0) and StatusBase BCA (0x0115F858) are IDENTICAL in 10 of 11 BCD positions (the 11th being the +96 BCD that differs between LTC and LGTC variants). This same pattern holds across 10 of 11 LTC/LGTC family classes.

**LGE-chain BCDs are SHARED ACROSS ALL 10 CLASSES**: the 3 BCDs at +4 (LgeBase 0x0115C6F8, LgeCommonMA 0x0115C714, LgeBasicMA 0x0115C730) and the 3 BCDs at +100 (LgeBase 0x0115D668, LgeCommonMA 0x0115D684, LgeBasicMA 0x0115D6A0) appear at the SAME byte addresses in all 10 BCAs. The same physical BCD instances are reused - elegant space saving because the BCDs describe non-class-specific inheritance relationships.

**dual-allocator-scope finding extends to ALL 10 LTC/LGTC classes**: each class has TWO independent non-polymorphic LGE allocator-state subobjects (actor-side via ActorBase at +4; Lua-side via LTC/LGTC at +100). Combined with the finding that LGE classes have no vftables (only data state), this means all 10 LTC/LGTC classes implement the dual-allocator architecture by design.

**LTC partition** (3 classes): GroupBase (BCS-Y-1588), ItemBase (BCS-Y-1589), WidgetHandle (BCS-Y-1590) - inherit from [[Component_Lua_GameEngine_LuaTentativeControl_TypeDescriptor]] (BCS-Y-1514) at offset +96, providing the Lua-side allocator subobject.

**LGTC partition** (7 classes + StatusBase = 8 total): Math (BCS-Y-1591), CommandBase (BCS-Y-1593), JudgeBase (BCS-Y-1594), QuestBase (BCS-Y-1595), String (BCS-Y-1596), Table (BCS-Y-1597), and StatusBase (BCS-Y-1497) - inherit from [[Component_Lua_GameEngine_LuaGlobalTentativeControl_TypeDescriptor]] (BCS-Y-1498) at offset +96, providing the Lua-side allocator subobject.

**Global is the OUTLIER** (BCS-Y-1592):, has 15 BCDs (not 11), 6 vftable positions (not 4), CHD attributes=0x05 (MI+AMBIGUOUS, not 0x01 MI). The extra 4 BCDs are the LuaThreadEndListenerInterface (LTELI, BCS-Y-1480) chain at +0x68. Deferred for full characterization.
